column2: Marc de Champagne is a French grape-pomace brandy (eau-de-vie de marc), not a whisky: distilled from the leftover pomace of Champagne-region grapes (Pinot Noir, Pinot Meunier, Chardonnay), a pomace-brandy category confirmed via Wikipedia's Eau de vie article (opened). The catalogue brand name is almost certainly leaked/miscategorised brandy rather than any actual whisky producer.
